title: Mini Calendar / Event Planner
description: Plan your days, schedule events, and manage recurring tasks with an easy-to-use calendar interface.
how_to_play:
1. Select a date from the calendar.
2. Add events with title, time, notes, and optional recurrence (daily, weekly, monthly).
3. Edit or delete events anytime.
4. Toggle display of recurring events.
5. Export events to CSV or import JSON files for backup or sharing.

Tips:
- Use the search bar to quickly find events.
- Set up recurring events to save time.
- Review your day’s events each morning to stay organized.
